information_definition.name: metric-weighted Gauss-Newton information
information_definition.I: sum_{n,k} J_nk^T W J_nk, J_nk = d yhat / d theta
information_definition.post_evaluation: theta_hat_D = each subset's own fitted parameters
information_definition.design_evaluation: theta_ref = 0 (neutral prior alpha=0.625), fixed zero-intervention baseline nominal curve
information_definition.regularizer_excluded: data-only J^T W J; second-difference regularizer not added

metrics.log_det: log det of the lambda_max-normalized spectrum + ridge*I

information_definition.normalization: spectrum is divided by its largest eigenvalue before log_det/trace_inv so metrics are scale-free and comparable across sample sizes
information_definition.jacobian_method: chain rule: d yhat/d alpha (central diff on alpha) x alpha_max sigmoid'(z) phi
